name: SaunaLife Model E7 Sauna Barrel | ERGO Series
description: SaunaLife Model E7 Sauna Barrel | ERGO Series SaunaLife's ERGO-Series Outdoor sauna barrels were crafted and engineered by sauna experts, providing customers with the ultimate in comfort, durability, and aesthetics when it comes to choosing a barrel sauna. Ergonomics – Barrel Sauna Comfort When purchasing an outdoor sauna barrel, it is important to consider bathing comfort by evaluating the diameter and bench/backrest configuration. While smaller barrels may have a lower price due to fewer materials, they may also have tradeoffs such as reduced door height, less comfortable benches, and restricted headroom. The tighter arc of smaller diameter barrels can also create challenges in seating posture, hinder standing upright, and require crouching when entering and exiting. The ERGO Series Sauna Barrels have a spacious 6’5” interior height. With its wide circumference, the benches can be ergonomically shaped and molded to fit comfortably. The spacious barrel design offers ample room for a curved backrest, providing genuine lumbar support. When choosing the knot-free, high-quality Thermo-Aspen seating material, touch and feel were prioritized to accommodate a variety of body sizes. Durability – A lifetime of outdoor bathing pleasure Did you know that Cedarwood lasts up to 2X longer than traditional wood used for saunas? Each SaunaLife barrel features 1.65” thick full-length staves that provide superior thermal resistance (R-value) and enclose the sauna for optimal heat retention. This eco-friendly Thermo-Aspen wood is dimensionally stable and perfect for outdoor saunas. It is also used to construct showers. The SaunaLife ERGO Series features ergonomically designed Thermo-Aspen benches and backrests (1.1” thick and 3-1/2” wide), which are 50% thicker than the industry standard. Ingenuity - Engineered to exceed expectations Though the design and installation process may seem simple, the ERGO-Series is filled with advanced barrel sauna technology. These outdoor spaces are designed to withstand the effects of water, so don't be afraid to splash around! This is made possible by our top-of-the-line 1-7/8" wide and 1/8" thick stainless steel barrel bands, which compress the sturdy staves and provide you with a luxurious wellness retreat. The SaunaLife Model E7 Sauna Barrel comes with a DIY watertight shingle kit that is essential for every barrel sauna. One of its standout features is the side-mounted drip edges that effectively manage rainwater. The barrel also has dual floor drains strategically placed - one under the sauna heater for easy water-tossing, and the other near the door for collecting cold plunge or pool water. And even if the barrel shifts out of level, the dual floor drains will provide reliable coverage. Illumination – Inside and out Showcasing the wood's natural beauty and enhancing the sauna experience is made possible with SaunaLife's low-voltage, waterproof LED lighting system. This superior white LED lighting, controlled by a Wi-Fi app and hand-held remote, allows for setting the perfect ambiance before entering the sauna. The heat and water certified (IP67) LED fixture provides an enchanting, dotless glow. Consider adding the E Sconce+ Package for two outdoor LED wall sconces and a secondary interior LED lightbar, expanding up to four white fixtures. Enhance the ambiance of your outdoor sauna with the ultimate backyard sauna party attraction, the E MOOD Lighting Package. Experience an infinite range of colors for both inspirational and relaxing visual effects. Beauty – A compliment to almost any outdoor oasis Experience the highest quality Nordic Spruce with SaunaLife's Model E7 Sauna Barrel from the ERGO Series. The rich golden color enhances the distinctive grain and rustic tight-knot charm of the wood. Enjoy the ergonomic design of the ultra-smooth Thermo-Aspen benches and backrests, made from grade-A wood that is free from knots and rich in color. Additionally, we provide a complimentary bottle of paraffin oil, a natural wax, to preserve and enrich the interior luster. Crafted in Northern Europe where sauna bathing is a common part of daily life, the SaunaLife E7 sauna brings the benefits of wellness directly to your backyard. With precision design from SaunaLife, you can experience a lifetime of health and relaxation at home. The E7 Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping. If your order is in stock and we process the charges to your credit card, it will ship within five business days from the date of your order. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is unclear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us. All sales are final for Custom made and Made-to-order products. Refunds & Returns If you need to exchange your product, you may do so. You, as the customer, are responsible for any shipping costs throughout any returns or exchange processes. Not all orders are available for return once they have shipped. We order products directly from the manufacturer. Therefore, if the manufacturer does not permit us to return a product, we cannot offer you a return. This often varies on a case-by-case basis; please reach out to us if you would like specific information on your brand and/or product. Due to drastically increasing LTL/freight shipping costs, any outright returns will incur a 25% cancellation fee + return shipping costs. If you are replacing the product with something else, we may be able to help you cover some of the costs depending on the product. Seller reserves the right to refuse to refund any deposit or payment or cancel any payment due, and any owing until Seller a) receives the goods b) has inspected the goods and c) in the Seller's discretion, has found the goods to be free of damage. All refunds will be provided within 5 business days once the product has been returned to the warehouse and inspected for damage. Shipping Times We promise to do our best to get your order to you as soon as possible.
